title: Learning From the Stubbornness of Others
verse: Those of Pharaoh’s servants who feared the Lord’s message hurried to bring their servants and livestock into the houses, but those who did not take the Lord’s message seriously left their servants and their cattle in the field.
observation: I heard someone once say, “Everyone has value, even if it is to be a bad example.” This is true. There are some things we can only learn by experiencing them for ourselves. However, there are many things we can learn by watching the successes and faithfulness of others. In today’s passage, the officials of Pharaoh had learned from the past and the difficulty they and others around them had experienced. Therefore, they listened to the Word of God and took precautions. Hopefully, those who watched the mercy they received learned from their example and followed their lead the next time. What can you learn from others today? What can others learn from you? How can you be an example of grace to someone today?
application: Think about the influences in your life right now. What can you learn about God through their influence?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for constantly leading us into more and more freedom.
